# perplexity.ge - AI Search, Real-Time Grounding & Enterprise Research

> perplexity.ge is Georgia's specialized resource center for Perplexity AI, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), grounded deep research, academic literature synthesis, and corporate intelligence workflows, curated by Giorgi Basilaia.

## Core Capabilities & Focus Areas

- [AI Search & Answer Engine Portal](https://perplexity.ge/): Practical mastery of Perplexity Pro, Pro Search, real-time web retrieval, and factual citations.
- [Academic & Scientific Synthesis](https://perplexity.ge/): Utilizing Perplexity Academic focus mode with Semantic Scholar, arXiv, and Google Scholar to accelerate research papers and literature reviews.
- [Corporate Intelligence & Market Audits](https://chatgpt.ge/corporate-training.html): Automated competitive monitoring, regulatory analysis, and market trend synthesis with verifiable sources.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Consulting](https://chatgpt.ge/corporate-training.html): Helping Georgian brands optimize their knowledge and data so AI engines (Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Gemini) accurately recommend and cite them.

## Lead Instructor & Academic Authority

- **Giorgi Basilaia:** Associate Professor, [Free University of Tbilisi](https://freeuni.edu.ge/ge/details/?person=giorgi-basilaia); 25+ years in IT systems, 14 scientific papers, 3388+ citations on Google Scholar, Google Gemini Certified Educator.
- **Free University Faculty Profile:** [freeuni.edu.ge](https://freeuni.edu.ge/ge/details/?person=giorgi-basilaia)
- **Academic Hub:** [basilaia.com](https://basilaia.com)

- [chatgpt.ge](https://chatgpt.ge): Flagship Generative AI courses and corporate training.
